name: ssr-reasoning-library
note: Six reusable reasoning candidates. Each candidate is wrapped in <thinking>...</thinking> before scoring; expected_actions are metadata, not forced actions.

r_GENERAL_KNOW.text: I recognize the main subject of this image and I already know the answer from general knowledge, so I can answer the question directly.

r_ANSWER_FROM_IMAGE.text: The information needed to answer is clearly visible in the image itself, so I can determine the answer by reading it directly from what I see.

r_ZOOM_DETAIL.text: The part of the image that matters for this question is small or hard to make out, so I should examine that region more closely before I decide.

r_IDENTIFY_BY_IMAGE.text: I cannot confidently tell what the specific entity in this image is from its appearance alone, so I should identify it by searching with the image itself before answering.

r_LOOKUP_FACT.text: I can tell what the entity in the image is, but I do not know the particular fact the question is asking about, so I should look that information up.

r_ANSWER_FROM_EVIDENCE.text: The details I have gathered so far already contain what the question is asking for, so I can now give the final answer.
